principle: NO pre-stored banks; live encyclopedia fetch only; maximum parallel tool-using agents; separate checker agents every step; search = integrity check not novelty gate. R11: Stage 1 spans the FULL breadth of human life/culture on one axis + newest-ML on the other; merge = ML technique x distant life/culture concept.

params.stage1_ml_whitespace_note: NEW (cycle-3, HIGH): cycle-2's dominant yield-limiter (per Opus audit) was ML-subarea SATURATION — every ML concept sat in a crowded fast-moving area, so 4/5 Stage-3 survivors collapsed at Stage 4 to very recent prior art. Steer ML fetch toward less-saturated corners; pair with stage2_crowdedness_penalty.
params.stage2_distinct_concept_note: NEW (cycle-3, HIGH): cycle-2 merge agents over-concentrated on versatile life concepts (Etak x3, Kigumi x2) -> only 5/24 distinct used, throttling the novelty engine. Enforce: no life concept reused across merges in a cycle.
params.stage3_analogy_collapse_probe_status: KEEP — cycle-2 CLEAR WIN: became the dominant, clean drop reason ('reduces to a named ML method'); the main integrity discriminator.
params.stage3_deep_priorart_note: NEW (cycle-3): Stage 4 found CLOSER competitors than Stage 3 (L-MTP, PosS, REINFORCE++, adaptive-decay). Run Stage-4-depth prior-art search already at Stage 3 to catch reduces-to-existing earlier and cut wasted tie-breaks.
params.stage3_life_axis_note: NEW (cycle-3, R11-specific): cycle-2 survivor's life axis (Kigumi) was judged DECORATIVE by the adversarial auditor (the ML idea stands with zero reference to the life concept). Flag merges whose life/culture mechanism is removable-without-loss — for an ML x life pipeline the life axis must be load-bearing.
params.stage3_tiebreak_status: REVISE — cycle-2 NET-WASH: all 3 tie-break recoveries died at Stage 4 as trivial variants (changed no final output) and showed a 3/3 pro-genuine bias. Keep as a DIAGNOSTIC (it correctly proved integrity!=niche by showing the rejecting checkers' reductions were factually wrong), but require the tie-breaker to independently RE-DERIVE the claimed reduction before overturning; consider a 2-agent tie-break.
params.checker_citation_note: STRENGTHENED (cycle-3): a checker cited arXiv:2603.20537 as Stage-5 closest-collision evidence; it does not resolve (likely self-hallucination), caught only by the Stage-6 audit. Add a post-stage sweep that verifies EVERY checker-cited arXiv ID resolves before it is recorded as evidence.

stage6b_expected_value_gate.status: KEEP — cycle-2 NECESSARY/load-bearing: correctly routed the lone survivor to SEED_ONLY instead of promoting a MODEST idea as a discovery.

convergence.binding_constraint_identified: ML-subarea saturation (whitespace-steering needed) + merge-agent life-concept over-concentration (breadth leak). Both addressed by new cycle-3 params.
convergence.notes: Both cycle 1 and cycle 2 yielded exactly 1 marginal CONFIRMED_WITH_CAVEATS survivor; cycle 2's EV gate + Stage 7 honestly reclassify it SEED_ONLY (cycle 1 lacked both and reported its survivor as 'the niche'). The algorithm is converging toward HONEST self-assessment; the remaining yield-limiter is now diagnosed, not mysterious.

metrics_history.final: GridFermi-PE (MODEST, CONFIRMED_WITH_CAVEATS) — reported as 'the niche' (no EV gate / no Stage 7 yet)

metrics_history.headline: Two of four new cycle-2 mechanisms earned their keep (analogy-collapse probe became the main integrity discriminator; the EV gate is the only thing preventing manufactured-survivor inflation and correctly stamped the survivor SEED_ONLY). R11 breadth fix worked at fetch but leaked at merge; tie-break was a net-wash. The pipeline filtered genuinely (~97% distributed mortality, a caught false-attribution, deeper-prior-art Stage-4 gate) and the audit diagnosed the binding yield-constraint (ML-subarea saturation).
